summary.text: Betsy Carr is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates for District 78, representing part of the city of Richmond, serving since 2010. The House's member profile lists committee assignments including Appropriations (vice chair), General Laws, and Transportation.

paragraphs.text: Betsy B. Carr was born in Norfolk, Virginia, according to the House's member profile.
The profile says she earned a B.A. from Hollins College in 1968.
The profile lists her as Minority Caucus Treasurer beginning in 2014.
It shows her as vice chair of the Appropriations Committee and chair of its Higher Education Subcommittee, and as chair of the Transportation Infrastructure and Funding subcommittee.
